steps.title: Analyze Form Inputs & Label Requirements
steps.description: Review input screens across the app to identify fields missing permanent top-positioned label TextViews.

steps.title: Update Add & Edit Mobile Screen Input Labels
steps.description: Add permanent English and Hindi field labels above Brand, Model, Model Number, IMEI 1, IMEI 2, Serial, RAM, Storage, Color, SKU, Prices, Notes, and Raw OCR input boxes.

steps.title: Update Stock In Screen Input Labels
steps.description: Ensure search and filter input fields maintain visible labels above search boxes during user interaction.

steps.title: Update Stock Out Screen Input Labels
steps.description: Add static top labels for Available Mobile Search, Selling Price, Customer Name, Customer Phone, and Warranty Notes.

steps.title: Update All Mobiles Inventory Screen Labels
steps.description: Add explicit field label for global search input field.

steps.title: Update OCR Result Screen Input Labels
steps.description: Format extracted text container with clear static label and typography.

steps.title: Verify Input Component IDs & Autofill Compatibility
steps.description: Confirm all existing View IDs and data binding mechanisms remain unchanged.

steps.title: Verify Hindi & English Localized Label Rendering
steps.description: Ensure typography, layout padding, and line spacing support bilingual text clearly across all density displays.

steps.title: Validate Validation & Camera OCR Auto-Fill Features
steps.description: Verify OCR auto-population, barcode scanning, manual entry, and IMEI validation remain completely functional.

steps.title: Building Bhagwati Stock
steps.description: Assemble release candidate debug build with updated visible input labels.
